subject.title: Livermore Area Recreation & Park District Board

text: My education and qualifications are: Since 2017 I have served the greater Livermore community on the LARPD Board of Directors. My lifelong interest in outdoor recreation and my ownership of a local running and hiking store motivated me to join LARPD, but I learned quickly that my background in corporate finance, technology, and law were just as useful as my enthusiasm for recreation. Following the pandemic, LARPD has enacted many programs to enhance the quality of life for the community, including instituting an annual playground renovation program, improving aquatics facilities, resurfacing sports fields, adding new community-focused programs, and working with the City and County to connect multiple multi-use trails. As a Director, I have also pushed aggressively to protect the taxes paid by our residents and to ensure those funds are spent in our community. We have much left to do. As a parent, business owner, and active member of our community, I want to continue that work.

text: My education and qualifications are: As a member of our community for over 34 years, my family has utilized and appreciated LARPD facilities, which include our parks, sport fields, community center and trails. I hold a BS Degree in Criminal Justice and have many postgraduate courses in Recreation. As one of the founding members of the Tri-Valley Pickleball Club, we grew this non-profit organization to over 600 members in just three years. I’ve also been a softball coach at Livermore High School for the past 24 years. During my 28 years in law enforcement, I managed our Community Policing Division, which was responsible for the Junior Giants program, 200 volunteers and a multi-million dollar budget. In addition, I coordinated events with the Hayward Area Recreation District, the Chamber of Commerce, Rotary and the Neighborhood Watch Program. I’m currently a pickleball instructor and liaison for LARPD. Together, we’ve collaborated to resolve community issues, planned events and scheduled classes. I’ve dedicated my life to public service and will continue to do so if elected to the Board. It would be a privilege to have your vote, so we can create more fulfilling parks and recreation experiences for everyone in our community!

text: My education and qualifications are: BA in Recreation Administration, Masters in Public Administration. I was General Manager for LARPD for 15-years and retired in 2018 capping a 45-year career in public parks and recreation management. I ask for your vote as I want to again serve this park district that I love in a new capacity, for the community that I love. As a 23-year resident of Livermore, I will work for vibrant and growing District programs and places that will help our diverse and hard-working community thrive. Do you value local parks, trails and activities that play an important part of your everyday life? Do you value continued energy and efforts that bring real results? So do I! I am not a one-issue candidate. I’ll work with our Board and staff to make our quality of life the best it can be, and stretch our dollars to get results. Your vote will place valuable experience and insights, together with a seasoned perspective on the Board for the future! Thanks for your vote!

text:
My education and qualifications are: My name is Mike Ralph, and I want to be your voice on the Livermore Area Recreation and Park District (LARPD) Board. For more than 20 years, I’ve proudly called Livermore home, raising three children while enjoying our parks, trails, and recreation programs. I hold a Bachelor of Science degree in Recreation Administration and have served 4 years as a Trustee of the LARPD Foundation, helping fund scholarships, park improvements, and senior programs. I have been a dedicated advocate for the Sunken Gardens Pump Track starting the first conversation in 2013 and was honored to help lead its inaugural first lap this past June. I also led efforts to provide free bicycle helmets to local riders, including students at Title I schools. I support safe, responsible e-bike use through education, clear regulations, and appropriate enforcement while distinguishing e-bikes from e-motos and electric motorcycles. I am also committed to preserving our Camp Shelly so future generations can continue enjoying this treasured Lake Tahoe campground. I will bring experience, practical leadership, and a fresh perspective to ensure LARPD continues to provide exceptional parks, trails, and recreation opportunities for our community. text: My education and qualifications are: As a LARPD Director for the past 32 years, I am proud of helping provide for your recreation needs. My long experience in park and recreation administration, budgeting and master planning makes me a knowledgeable and effective policy maker. I have served both state and local levels dealing with parks, open space and historic preservation. I am a Past President of the California Association of Recreation and Park Districts. If re-elected, my goals are to maintain a strong volunteer program; promote innovative facilities like spray parks, pickleball and bike tracks; advocate for universal access; and safeguard important programs like ESS, aquatics, youth sports and senior services. LARPD residents care about their parks, trails, and open space. For over 75 years LARPD has maintained what we have, spent your tax dollars wisely and continues to plan for future needs. I encourage cooperation among the park and school districts and the city to provide our joint constituencies with efficient local government. In future I want to continue to represent you at LARPD to ensure we remain the leader for vital recreation facilities and programs that enhance your quality of life in Livermore.

text: My education and qualifications are: I was honored to serve on the LARPD Board of Directors after being elected in 2010. I completed a partial term before being elected to the Livermore City Council in 2011, where I gained valuable experience in public service, fiscal responsibility, and community leadership. During my years of public service and work as both a registered nurse and nursing professor, I earned a Bachelor of Science in Nursing, a Master of Science in Nursing Education, a Master of Arts in Organizational Management, and a Doctor of Education. After serving on the City Council, I focused on completing my doctorate and my nursing career. Now that I am partially retired, I have the time and energy to once again dedicate myself to serving our community through the LARPD board. I am committed to preserving and enhancing our parks, trails, and open spaces while supporting the recreational opportunities that make Livermore such a wonderful place to live. From hiking and pickleball to youth, senior, and family programs, I believe LARPD enriches the lives of residents of all ages. I would be honored to earn your support.
